patents.title: Method and system for modifying search query for a user
patents.also: Also filed via PCT (WO 2023/277342) and in India.
patents.description: Rewrites a search query using the user's current context and an on-device personalised knowledge graph, so search returns more relevant results.

patents.title: Method and system for classifying one or more hyperlinks in a document
patents.also: A continuation is pending (US 2026/0187343 A1). Also filed via PCT (WO 2024/080794), in China and in India.
patents.description: Sorts the hyperlinks in a document into categories by analysing the text around each link, without opening the linked content.

patents.title: Methods and electronic devices for adding entity of interest to captured image
patents.also: Also filed via PCT (WO 2026/079564) and in India.
patents.description: Adds a missing person to an already-captured photo, generating a suitable pose and placement from other relevant images.

patents.title: A method and a device for capturing a desired event
patents.description: The user describes the moment they want in a prompt; the camera matches that description against the live stream frame by frame and captures when the event appears.

patents.title: Method and system for providing personalized audio-visual experience to a user based on an event
patents.also: Application 202141009613. Grant notified in the Official Journal of the Patent Office, No. 10/2024.
patents.description: Senses the excitement of a live event and plays sounds and visuals matched to the user's profile.

patents.title: Method and electronic device for generating personalized activities for a user
patents.also: Application 202141009075. Grant notified in the Official Journal of the Patent Office, No. 12/2025.
patents.description: A device such as a social robot learns a user's preferences and its relationship with them, then initiates personalised activities.

patents.title: Method and system for monitoring physical fitness
patents.also: Application 202041027276. Grant notified in the Official Journal of the Patent Office, No. 43/2024.
patents.description: A conversational fitness assistant that understands natural-language input in context and reports results back in natural language.
